metadata.title: That 1 kill where I aimed at the floor and Valorant was like ‘Sure, why not?’
metadata.description:
Wait, did I just get a kill for literally doing nothing?
Enemy must have been showing me mercy or just confused.
Click if your best shots are accidents gone viral!
Valorant’s logic strikes again.

Tap if your aim’s a mystery but the kills still happen!
